local_reimplementations.name: AppMapKit (local)
local_reimplementations.notes: IMPORTANT AMBIGUITY, flagged rather than guessed: this app does NOT depend on @narduk-enterprises/narduk-mapkit-nuxt (absent from package.json; nuxt.config.ts modules are only ['@nuxt/content','@nuxt/fonts','nitro-cloudflare-dev']). It DOES `extends: ['@narduk-enterprises/narduk-nuxt-template-layer-maps', ...]` (nuxt.config.ts line ~21-26). The local file's own doc comment reads 'AppMapKit -- Reusable Apple MapKit JS map component' and Nuxt's directory-prefix convention registers apps/web/app/components/app/MapKit.vue as the tag <AppMapKit> -- the exact same tag name narduk-mapkit-nuxt ships. Because a local file at the same relative path as a layer file overrides the layer's version in Nuxt, this could be (a) a full independent 915-loc reimplementation, or (b) a local override shadowing an equivalent component the narduk-nuxt-template-layer-maps legacy layer itself already provides. This repo's node_modules was not installed (clone-only, per lane rules), so this could not be resolved from this app alone -- recommend L0 or a follow-up check narduk-nuxt-template-layer-maps's own runtime/app/components/app/MapKit.vue (or equivalent) directly. Either way, this app is NOT consuming narduk-mapkit-nuxt's current AppMapKit.

notes: Largest and most content-heavy app in this lane by far (73 vue files, 43 pages, 4 layouts -- a local-info portal covering weather/pollen/bats/food/real-estate/outdoors/events/culture for Austin). NO data table anywhere: the only <table> hits (real-estate/market-trends.vue, property-tax-guide.vue) are static markdown-style HTML tables inside editorial content pages, confirmed by direct read. Nuxt's directory-prefix auto-import convention (components/map/SpotList.vue -> <MapSpotList>) meant naive filename-tag greps undercounted consumers for every component in a subdirectory; consumer counts here were re-verified against the prefixed tag names. The single most important finding is the AppMapKit name collision (see local_reimplementations) -- it is NOT safe to assume this repo is 'adopting' narduk-mapkit-nuxt just because <AppMapKit> appears 11 times. No UI-relevant defect history in gh issues/PRs (only deploy/template-sync chores and one unrelated auth bug).
